images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable. A dominant protagonist, an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. In a Prehistoric valley viewed through safe forced perspective, the stealth museum infiltrator stands at a storm-lit shattered mountain shrine beside a giant cracked aquarium window. A whale-scale encounter rises as a harmless projection, its whale-sized silhouette crossing a towering storm wall; the cat makes one paw dramatically raised with a dramatically annoyed face. The enormous city is a living tabletop model, revealed by tiny moving streets below the glass. Outcome: the broken landmark locks safely back into place with visible mechanical alignment. Include Whale-scale encounter, broken landmark locks safely back into place, the enormous city is a living tabletop model, one paw dramatically raised, towering storm wall, one decisive action, safe VFX debris, transparent supports, realistic glass, no danger, no text, no logos, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D render, no malformed anatomy.
